content.summary: Olin Corporation (NYSE:OLN) is closing its Guarujá, Brazil Epoxy production site as part of a cost saving plan. Management expects the Epoxy segment to return to profitability in 2026 following these changes. Olin's Winchester ammunition business is raising prices due to higher raw material costs.
